name: Release0
author: Release0

sections.description:
Gather 4x more responses with interactive chat applications powered by Release0.

👉 Design stunning conversational apps and seamlessly integrate them into your WordPress site.
👉 Release0 enables you to launch chat-based agent apps that blend seamlessly with your product, offering an optimal user experience.
👉 With Release0, responses are captured immediately after the first question, giving you insights into when users tend to abandon your form.

This plugin is built on Release0, a platform designed for creating and embedding conversational agents directly into your WordPress site.
💁‍♂️ Learn more about Release0: https://release0.com/

External services

This plugin connects to the Release0 platform via API to enable AI-powered chat automation and workflow integration within your WordPress site.
It communicates with Release0 servers to load and execute chatbot workflows embedded on your site. Depending on the configuration, it may pass visitor metadata (e.g. referrer, UTM parameters) and message content to personalize the chat experience and trigger automated actions.
All data processing and automation logic is securely handled by Release0. For more information, please refer to the Release0 Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Add the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Activate your Release0 agent with the “Release0” admin button located in the sidebar
